items.title: Identity-based reaping + soxe doctor + status reconciliation
items.evidence: soxe doctor (cmdDoctor) scans registry extensions, builds service env with SOX_SERVICE_ID, calls findOrphansByServiceId, and reports cross-build strays per inv:list-never-lies. findOrphansByServiceId returns env-match OR argv-fallback, covering the adversarial stray case. Adversarial stray test (reaper.spec.ts) spawns with different argv, proves OLD path-based reaper misses it, NEW env-based reaper finds it. Negative control: wrong service ID yields no match. findOrphansByServiceId falls back to argv token matching when SOX_SERVICE_ID absent. Dual match (both env+argv) finds the process with no false negative. cmdDoctor removes stale configEnv/svcEnv that were unused after the match refactor. 171 host-runtime tests + 42 sox tests pass.
notes: SOX_SERVICE_ID env var injected into supervisor spawn (supervisor.ts)
reaper.ts: findOrphansByServiceId() matches by SOX_SERVICE_ID env var
readProcessEnv() reads process env via ps -o env
cmdDoctor() scans registry, detects cross-build strays via service id
Adversarial stray test: mock ps-based env read for 99999 pid
Fallback: argv token matching when no SOX_SERVICE_ID env is set
Dual match (env+argv) with no false negative

items.title: Unload-then-reap on every kill surface; fix stale os-unit comment
items.evidence: unloadOwnedOsUnitsBeforeReap() wired into cmdStart (code path: daemon restart, F3 resurrection guard) and restartProxyBackend (service proxy restart). Both sites call unload-then-reap BEFORE verified-stop so the OS supervisor does NOT immediately respawn the pid we kill (the F3 resurrection loop). os-unit.ts header comment fixed — 'Config-file-driven service provisioning' → 'Runtime-unit for sox supervised services' accurate description. [inv:unload-then-reap] invariants documented at both call sites with §8.4/§8.5 cross-references. 171 host-runtime tests + 42 sox tests pass.
